title: Monday outbound sprint - micro-hacks and follow-ups
content:
Quick context / mission: 2-hour morning sprint to clear top 12 touches. Prioritize demos booked, warm trials, and 3 high-value cold attempts (BrightFrame, Ledgerly, AtlasLogic). Keep voicemails short, push to calendar.

Today blockers: slow reply from SRE at BrightFrame (waiting on data retention Qs), legal loop at Ledgerly — escalate to Solutions Eng for contract clarifications.

Numbers (handy): quota: 80% month-to-date; closed ARR needed to hit plan: $42k; demo conversion target this week: 4 demos -> 1 PoC.

Priority call list (order = try now -> later):
1) BrightFrame — Mariana Soto (PA) 415-555-0183 — warm inbound trial, paused on retention question. Last: left note 6/18. Next action: call, ask if we can share simplified retention doc; if no answer leave short voicemail: 'Amelia from Redwood, quick question on retention for your trial, 650-***, keeping it short' and follow-up email w/ 1-pager. Tags: trial, high-touch.

2) Ledgerly — Marcus Chen (CISO) 212-555-0220 — red flag: legal looping. Last: demo 6/10, asked for SOC2 excerpt. Next action: ping Priya to fast-track legal template and schedule a 30-min with Solutions Eng. Email subject test A/B: 'SOC2 excerpt attached — Redwood trial follow-up' vs 'Quick SOC2 excerpt for Ledgerly — short read'.

3) AtlasLogic — Sophie Kwan (Head of ML) 510-555-0117 — cold sequence, already on 2nd email. Next action: call window 10:30–11:00, script: 'quick intro, 30s value: predictable inference costs + private deployment options for regulated data, ask if they run in-house or cloud'. If no answer, LinkedIn message with 1-line value + calendar link. Tags: cold, target-accounts.

4) Halcyon Retail — Ryan O. (Director) 323-555-0199 — demo scheduled 7/14, pre-call to align exec expectations. Action: send agenda draft, ask for attendees, confirm data sample.

5) Nimbus Health — intake form lead, phone missing. Action: hunt CRM for alt contact + 1 cold email.

6) GreenCart (small ecomm) — follow-up: PO requested earlier. Action: check with finance if onboarding discount applied; push for signature via DocuSign.

7) Prospective trial re-engage list (3 contacts) — quick 60s check-in + 1 novelty email w/ micro-case.

Voicemail templates (quick):
- Warm trial VM: 'Hi [Name], Amelia from Redwood Inference. Quick question about your trial settings — can I grab 2 minutes? Call me at 650-555-0100. Thanks!'
- Cold VM (short): 'Hi [Name], Amelia at Redwood. We help teams cut per-token inference cost while keeping latency stable. Quick call? 650-555-0100.'

Email snippets to copy/paste:
- For BrightFrame (trial): 'Mariana — following up on your trial. Quick one: what retention window do you need for KV cache? Attached is a 1‑page note that might help. Can we hop on a 10-min call to unblock? —Amelia'
- For Ledgerly (legal): 'Marcus — attaching the SOC2 excerpt we discussed. If helpful, Priya (cc) can join a short legal sync to cover contract language. When's 30 min good this week?'
- Cold touch (AtlasLogic): 'Sophie — noticed your team publishes models for inference. Redwood helps reduce inference variability and unit cost; curious if you run inference on-prem or cloud? If yes, coffee chat next week?'

Mini-experiments to try today (tracking):
- Subject line A/B for Ledgerly (see above)
- 20s value statement instead of 30s on first call for cold accounts (measure reach -> cal booked)
- Voicemail + same-day LinkedIn DM for AtlasLogic to increase response rate

Follow-up tracker (quick):
- BrightFrame: email sent? No -> send after call.
- Ledgerly: attach SOC2? Yes -> need legal sync scheduled.
- AtlasLogic: LinkedIn DM drafted -> send if call fails.

Notes to self (quick wins):
- Keep calendar blocked 9:00–11:00 for call blitz, 11:00–12:00 for admin (send follow-ups, update CRM).
- Use Redwood demo clip link (v2) when sharing calendar invite (short 60s video).
- Update AE playbook snippet: how we price trials for retail vs fintech (file note -> send to Darius).

Unresolved questions / follow-ups to log in JIRA:
- AE-4829: request for templated SOC2 excerpt (assigned to Priya)
- AE-4915: create concise retention FAQ for trials (todo: write 1-pager)

End-of-sprint checklist (tick as done):
- [ ] 6 outreach calls attempted
- [ ] 3 voicemails left (if needed)
- [ ] CRM updated with next action and date
- [ ] Send 2 follow-up emails with attachments
- [ ] Log learnings in #ae-pipeline Slack (quick 4-line summary)

Random quick ideas to capture (brain dump):
- Turn SOC2 excerpt into a 1-click download on trial dashboard to reduce friction.
- Micro-case for website: 'How BrightFrame lowered inference cost 28% in pilot' (needs approval).

If time left: scope intro call template for Solutions Eng to speed up legal/tech bridging (10-min outline).

Timestamped notes: 9:12 AM — first BrightFrame ring, voicemail left. 9:34 AM — Marcus responded via email asking for calendar options; pinging Priya. 10:05 AM — AtlasLogic no answer, DM queued.

---
Files to attach/send after sprint: SOC2-excerpt-v1.pdf, retention-one-pager.docx, demo-clip-v2.mp4

Endnotes: keep energy high, focus on unblockable demos. Quick wins compound.
